name: Tinfox / warm fox
direction: A restrained precision-instrument finish with warm ivory surfaces, fox-orange outer limb panels, charcoal lower legs and small functional accents.
studio_notes: Keep the same part-to-color assignments as the CAD viewer.
Use matte ivory and orange polymer, satin charcoal structural finishes, subdued metal and reflective dark optical surfaces.
Express the fox character through color placement and a friendly face; do not add decorative appendages that compromise mobility or serviceability.
Reserve orange for the outer thighs, head crown and selected service controls. Keep labels small, legible and functional.
Interference highlighting is a review overlay, not a manufactured finish.
